extracted.summary: A solicitor asks whether funding of £32,000 for disbursements and counsel is available for a client's personal injury claim arising from a road traffic accident.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry, which we have received and logged. So that we can consider it properly, we would be grateful for further details: the jurisdiction in which the claim is proceeding, the current stage of the case, the pleaded or estimated value of the claim, and any proposed security. It would also help to know whether any other funding or insurance arrangements are already in place. We will review the information and come back to you once we have it.
